description: Source code for the class PsiResourceFile, which extends ResourceFile and implements Iterable<ResourceItem>. It manages resource files in Android development, handling resource items, duplicates, and associated PsiFile objects.

classes.name: PsiResourceFile
classes.description: A class representing a resource file associated with a PsiFile, supporting resource item management and duplicate handling.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the File object corresponding to the PsiFile, converting from VirtualFile if necessary.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the PsiFile.

methods.name: setPsiFile
methods.description: Sets a new PsiFile and updates qualifiers, folder configuration, and folder type accordingly.

methods.name: addItems
methods.description: Adds multiple ResourceItems to the resource file.

methods.name: removeItems
methods.description: Removes multiple ResourceItems from the resource file.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a single ResourceItem, handling duplicates.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a ResourceItem, managing duplicates and reordering if necessary.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces an old ResourceItem with a new one.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the ResourceItems, including duplicates if present.
